title: GLP-1 myth flip — the pill + tirzepatide label
caption:
Myth: your GLP-1 doesn't touch your birth control. Tirzepatide (Mounjaro/Zepbound) label says an oral pill can work less well — back it up for 4 weeks after starting and after each dose bump. Ask your pharmacist.
Which myth next? 👇
www.aiforheratx.org
#glp1 #womenshealth #birthcontrol #zepbound #mounjaro #womenshealthmatters

scenes.text: Tirzepatide slows how fast your stomach empties. A swallowed pill can absorb less because of it.
phrases: The shot slows your stomach down.
That's part of how it keeps you full.
